long_biography.plain_text:
After leaving retail, Arthur M. Blank bought the Atlanta Falcons and made professional sport the centre of his family business portfolio. He later founded Atlanta United and developed Mercedes-Benz Stadium, assembling a group that also includes PGA TOUR Superstore. Six shared values place service, employees and community impact alongside commercial performance.

Blank's philanthropy reflects the example of his mother Molly, whose commitment to tikkun olam shaped his approach to giving. His family foundation concentrates on Atlanta and Montana, funding work in youth development, mental health, the environment and neighbourhood renewal. He has committed most of his wealth to charitable causes through the Giving Pledge.
